core_obligations: Given the cited Kato finite-dimensional perturbation, enlargement/factorization, hypocoercivity and Gearhart–Pruss inputs, transport multiplication v·xi is not L-bounded in the author setting, so the desired uniform spectrum/projector and dual-dissipation estimates do not follow by direct invocation. The author builds resolvent estimates across the Hilbert hierarchy from the A+B splitting, rectifies the moving small spectral subspace onto kerL, exploits isotropy to separate the multiple incompressible block and three simple modes, and computes quantitative expansions before closing the all-frequency semigroup/dual-energy bounds. The enlarged and regularized variants include the original bootstrap that transports projector regularity across spaces. Count this complete spectral framework as one H3 result,including its author variants rather than each matrix/projector helper.
